title: achras calderonii
intro: Achras calderonii, commonly known as the Mayan nut, is a tropical evergreen tree native to Central America, particularly in Mexico and Guatemala. This plant is valued for its edible nuts, which have been reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Achras calderonii include its potential to help manage cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
